The following is a list of '''missions featured''' in {{VI}}. The game's storyline follows [[Jason Duval]] and [[Lucia Caminos]] as they become involved in criminal activities throughout the [[State of Leonida]].

The main storyline is divided into five chapters, beginning with a prologue that introduces the protagonists and their relationship. Some missions can be completed in different orders, while others become available only after certain story events.

This article lists the main storyline missions in their approximate order of progression.

==Main Story Missions==

===Prologue===
The prologue introduces the relationship between [[Jason Duval]] and [[Lucia Caminos]], beginning approximately two years before the events of the main storyline.

Jason and Lucia first meet when Jason attempts to steal a car that Lucia had already stolen for her mother, [[Mia Caminos]]. The pair subsequently begin a romantic relationship and have a son, [[Tomás]].

Their circumstances change when Lucia is arrested following a bank robbery, during which she leaves Tomás at a coffee shop. Their son is subsequently taken into child protective services while Lucia is imprisoned.

Several months later, Lucia is offered an opportunity for early release as part of a trial intended to reduce prison overcrowding. She must wear an electronic ankle monitor as a condition of her release.

===Chapter 1: Just Like Paradise===
The first chapter takes place primarily in the [[Leonida Keys]], focusing on Jason's work for local drug trafficker [[Brian Heder]] and his associates [[Cal Hampton]] and [[Donnie]].

While continuing his involvement in Brian's smuggling operations, Jason prepares for Lucia's release from prison and the possibility of rebuilding their relationship.

Following Lucia's return, the pair begin working together and attempt to establish a new life. However, their involvement with Brian's criminal operations and a wealthy acquaintance named [[Mattia]] eventually places them in greater danger.

|[[Jason Duval|Jason]] and [[Cal Hampton|Cal]] assist [[Donnie]] with a cocaine delivery using one of [[Brian Heder|Brian's]] seaplanes. When the receiving gang, the [[Kingfishers]], discovers a discrepancy in the shipment and takes Donnie hostage, Jason must rescue him and escape with the seaplane.
|-
| '''[[Gear Up]]'''
|Jason visits [[Ammu-Nation (HD Universe)|Ammu-Nation]] to purchase a long gun, preparing himself for more dangerous work.
|-
| '''[[Just a Scratch]]'''
|Jason takes his [[Ganado]] to [[Coastal Auto Care]] for repairs and a respray, introducing the game's vehicle repair and customization mechanics.
|-
| '''[[Lab Fees]]'''
|Jason visits a local gift shop to collect overdue rent on behalf of Brian Heder, discovering that the business is involved in more than selling souvenirs.
|-
| '''[[Unwanted Attention]]'''
|Jason meets Cal while he is fishing, before the pair travel to a police impound in [[Hamlet]] to recover a vehicle. After stealing the car and attracting police attention, Jason must evade the authorities and return home.
|-
| '''[[Pipework]]'''
|Jason visits [[Mandy (GTA 6)|Mandy]], one of Brian's tenants, to collect her overdue rent. Mandy refuses to pay until her blocked kitchen sink is repaired, forcing Jason to carry out plumbing work while dealing with her romantic advances.
|-
| '''[[Hey Arnold!]]'''
|Brian asks Jason and Cal to help locate [[Arnold (GTA 6)|Arnold]], a former associate who has been avoiding him following problems with the Kingfishers. After confronting Arnold, Jason pursues him through the area and can choose whether to kill or spare him.
|-
| '''[[Island Dreams]]'''
|Jason accompanies [[Kenton]] on a scuba-diving excursion disguised as a bachelor party, searching a shipwreck for valuable items. When one of the divers becomes trapped underwater and a shark approaches the group, Jason must help resolve the situation before returning to the surface.
|-
| '''[[Feng Shui]]'''
|Cal visits Jason at his house and notices that he has been preparing for Lucia's return. The pair rearrange the furniture while discussing Jason's past relationship with Lucia and his plans for their future.
|-
| '''[[Coming Home]]'''
|Jason collects Lucia following her release from Hamlet Correctional and takes her to [[The Rusty Anchor]], where she reunites with her former prison acquaintance [[Kat]] and meets Mattia. During the evening, Jason becomes involved in a fight with members of the [[Aviators]], forcing him and Lucia to flee from the police.
|-
| '''[[Clean Up After Donnie]]'''
|Following another unsuccessful drug delivery, Donnie loses a package in the [[Grassrivers]]. Cal locates its signal, allowing Jason to retrieve the drugs from a group of fishermen before delivering them to Donnie's trailer.
|-
| '''[[Buck Me]]'''
|Lucia asks Jason for his banking information, only to discover that he does not have a bank account. The pair visit a local [[Fleeca]] branch, where Jason's poor credit history prevents him from opening an account. They are instead introduced to the [[BuckMe]] application.
|-
| '''[[Down to Earth]]'''
|Brian summons Jason to his marina for another cocaine delivery involving a new broker. Lucia accompanies Jason in a [[Dodo]] seaplane, but the arrangement turns into a shootout when the broker fails to pay the dealers. After returning home, Lucia must explain her absence to her probation officer.
|-
| '''[[Clear Skies]]'''
|Brian orders Jason to supervise Donnie during another smuggling operation near [[Southwind]] and [[Mile Zero Air Station]]. After helping a pilot land undetected, Donnie secretly arranges a deal with [[The Devil's Dozen]], who take him hostage. Jason must rescue him before the pair escape.
|-
| '''[[Building a Life]]'''
|Jason returns home to find Lucia assembling a table. The pair compete to see who can assemble their section faster before moving the finished furniture into place. A montage follows, depicting their everyday life together.
|-
| '''[[Day Release]]'''
|Jason and Lucia meet Kat and Mattia at The Rusty Anchor before joining them aboard Mattia's yacht. Lucia participates in a [[Seashark]] race, and the group later travels to [[Vice City (HD Universe)|Vice City]], where Jason and Lucia drive a [[Zorrusso]] and visit a hotel and [[NINE1NINE]]. Mattia subsequently offers the pair a job worth [[Money|$]]10,000.
|-
| '''[[Swamped]]'''
|Brian takes Jason to a Kingfishers camp to settle their ongoing dispute, where they discover that Donnie has been killed. After the meeting turns into an ambush, the Kingfishers kidnap [[Lori Heder|Lori]], forcing Jason and Brian to pursue her captors by helicopter and boat.
|-
| '''[[Don Gone]]'''
|Following Donnie's death, Brian orders Jason to remove evidence of his involvement in their criminal operations. Jason visits Donnie's trailer, collects his belongings, and destroys his vehicle to make it appear that Donnie has left town.
|-
| '''[[Recalibration]]'''
|Concerned about Cal following Donnie's death, Jason and Lucia visit him to offer their support. The trio go fishing together before returning to Cal's house to prepare a meal.
|-
| '''[[Tourist Trap]]'''
|Jason and Lucia accept Mattia's offer of a well-paid job and travel to a visitor center to collect a bag from a locker. The assignment turns out to be a trap involving corrupt police officers. Jason is seriously injured during the confrontation, forcing Lucia to fight their way out and escape by boat.
|-
| '''[[Home Sweet Home (GTA 6)|Home Sweet Home]]'''
|With Jason receiving medical treatment, Lucia returns to their house in [[Key Lento]] to collect his belongings. She discovers intruders inside the property and must escape when the house catches fire, before evading a police search of the surrounding area.
|-
| '''[[Discharge Time]]'''
|Lucia travels to a hospital in Vice City to reunite with Jason, but the pair are attacked by armed men pursuing them. They fight their way out of the hospital and escape toward [[Kelly County]], bringing the first chapter to an end.
|}
